status_semantics.CANDIDATE_AWAITING_USER: A named review asset exists but has no user visual acceptance; it is inventory-only, non-loadable, and cannot seed sprite production yet.
status_semantics.MISSING_ART: No approved exact visual source exists for this requested form/pose.
status_semantics.FORBIDDEN_HISTORY: Trace-only path/SHA; fatal in any active binding or positive art derivation.
